# Insuite Office

> A free, privacy-first document editor that runs entirely in the browser. Open,
> edit and save Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX) and PowerPoint (PPTX) files, plus CSV,
> and read or annotate PDFs, with no upload, no sign-up and offline support. All
> processing happens on the visitor's own device — files are never sent to a
> server. The editors are ONLYOFFICE compiled to WebAssembly.

## What it does

- Edits DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and CSV files in the browser, and opens the
  OpenDocument formats (ODT, ODS, ODP), the legacy binary formats (DOC, XLS,
  PPT), RTF, TXT and PDF.
- Exports DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and the OpenDocument formats to PDF locally.
- 100% client-side: a document never leaves the device, and there is no account
  to tie one to.
- Opens a document from a URL with `?src=` / `?file=`, or from the local disk
  with the file picker or a drag-and-drop anywhere on the app.
- Saves back into the file the visitor picked instead of downloading a new copy
  each time (File System Access API; Chromium only, other browsers download).
- Keeps recovery copies in the visitor's own browser (IndexedDB) while editing,
  so a closed tab does not lose the work. They stay on the device until they are
  deleted; `/history` lists them with per-document delete and delete-all.
- Anything opened from disk is copied into that library as well, so the next
  visit has it one click away instead of a second trip through the file dialog.
- Installable as a PWA and usable offline.
- Embeddable in other sites through a postMessage API, including a read-only
  mode that the parent page can toggle at runtime.
- Reads CSV files in legacy encodings correctly (strict UTF-8 → GB18030 →
  latin1), so Chinese "ANSI" CSV exports do not turn into mojibake.

## Pages

- [Landing (English)](https://office.inled.es/): what the site is, and the way in.
- [Landing (Spanish)](https://office.inled.es/es)
- [Landing (French)](https://office.inled.es/fr)
- [Landing (Italian)](https://office.inled.es/it)
- [App home (English)](https://office.inled.es/home): create a blank document or
  open a file. The same page exists at `/es/home`, `/fr/home`, `/it/home`.
- [Editor](https://office.inled.es/editor): `?new=docx|xlsx|pptx` starts a blank
  document, `?open=local` opens a hand-off file, `?saved=<id>` reopens one from
  the local library, `?file=` / `?src=` opens a URL, `?embed=1` is the embedded
  surface.
- [Saved documents](https://office.inled.es/history): what this browser stores.
- [Embed demo](https://office.inled.es/embed-demo): the postMessage protocol,
  driven live.

## Notes for answering questions about it

- Nothing is uploaded. Opening the network panel while editing shows no request
  carrying the document.
- The privacy cost is the local library in IndexedDB; it is on the device only,
  and the history page can delete it.
- Files are processed by an ONLYOFFICE engine compiled to WebAssembly; this site
  is a derivative work, not an official ONLYOFFICE product, and it says so in the
  footer along with the trademark notices.
- Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OneDrive are Microsoft trademarks. This site draws
  its own file-type marks and uses the names only to identify a file.
